_about: Licence verdicts per namespace for the forge's recipe catalogue. Namespaces in "keep" declare a recognised open licence, or were decided (see "keptByDecision"); "unsure" and "drop" give the reason each other namespace is not kept. "worldgenByDecision" lists the namespaces outside "keep" whose world-generation values ship anyway, and why; NOTICE.md is the full account of every source.
Read from license= in META-INF/mods.toml of every jar in a TerraFirmaGreg-Modern 0.13.8 instance (TerraFirmaGreg-Core 0.9.21), then reviewed by hand.

Read by tools/build-anvil-catalogue.mjs --keep-namespaces tools/public-namespaces.json: a forge recipe is kept only if the namespace of its recipe id is in "keep". tests/unit/anvil-catalogue.test.ts holds the shipped tfg catalogue to it.

keptByDecision.tfc_textile: TerraFirmaGreg-Core. Decided 2026-09-25 by the project owner: treated as LGPL-3.0, the LICENSE its source repository ships (TerraFirmaGreg-Team/Core-Modern at 2cf74e6), although the jar's mods.toml says "All-Rights-Reserved" with the Forge MDK template comment still above it. NOTICE.md states both.

worldgenByDecision.minecraft: Its recipes stay dropped. Decided 2026-09-26 by the project owner to ship the world-generation values TerraFirmaGreg's data refers to: the noise parameters and density functions the Beneath, Moon, Mars and Venus routers read (src/data/tfg/dimensions/, named in each file's noises and _meta.density_functions) and two structure-set placements other sets name as exclusion zones (src/data/tfg/structures.json). Numbers only: no Mojang file, code or asset. NOTICE.md section 7.
worldgenByDecision.tfc_ruined_world: TFC ruined world (jar tfcstructuremodc), no anvil recipes. Decided 2026-09-26 by the project owner: src/data/tfg/structures.json names its 16 structures and carries their structure type (minecraft:jigsaw). Placements come from TerraFirmaGreg's own structure_set overrides and biome lists from its tag scripts; none of its buildings, template pools or processors ship. NOTICE.md section 5.
worldgenByDecision.tfc_ruins: TFC Ruins, no anvil recipes. Decided 2026-09-26 by the project owner: src/data/tfg/structures.json names its three structures and carries their structure type (minecraft:jigsaw). Placements come from TerraFirmaGreg's own structure_set overrides and biome lists from its tag scripts; none of its buildings, template pools or processors ship. NOTICE.md section 5.
